answer: At a harbor lotus nursery, agents use a mirror array to spot leaf disease. A monitor gains market quota only after 30 days of unpredictable signed challenges requiring a fresh image from its dedicated calibrated camera; each device serial supports one active lease. Opening aliases creates no extra readings. To run 100 identities, an attacker must buy, calibrate, and power 100 cameras for a month, then post a bond on each for random field audits. Stolen certificates or a wealthy camera farm can still beat the rule, so serial revocation and per-operator quota caps remain necessary.
